title: One Time provider Billing UI compiler

reasons: The packet asks for a complete provider Billing UI with overview, catalog, billing, automations, settings, and responsive proof.
The packet includes payment, Stripe, access, notice, refund, and release boundaries.
The packet explicitly requires Product Quality workflow before UI completion.
likely_external_provider_blockers: Live Stripe key/webhook values are not approved for tracked files.
Live customer charges are out of scope.
Live notice/customer batch sends are out of scope.
Live refunds and access mutations are out of scope.
Hosted Railway test-mode variable propagation requires target guard proof before any write.
recommended_packet_sequence: Preserve raw packet and register requirements.
Audit current provider shell and existing billing/payment surfaces.
Split Billing UI into focused implementation packets if more than three routes or four files are touched.
Implement only after Definition of Ready passes.
Run action/route registry, accessibility, focused tests, screenshots, deploy, and live smoke before Done.
ramble_router.next_exact_packet: 01-current-state-visual-audit for One Time provider Billing UI

operator_intent_summary: Create a provider-scoped Billing UI for One Time that exposes billing operations clearly while keeping real charges, sends, refunds, and access changes approval-gated.
raw_quotes: Do not add another giant always-open wall to the Operations monolith.
Do not show raw IDs or debug text in the main overview.
Workspace owner/admin can manage products/prices/publish live prices within provider workspace, but publishing price must not charge/start campaign.

decisions_captured.decision: Workspace owners/admins may manage products and prices, but publishing a price must not charge customers or start the campaign.
Live activation requires a separate exact launch packet before real charge, refund, send, or access mutation.

out_of_scope: No live billing notice batch send.
No live access grant or revoke.
No Stripe Connect, transfer, payout, commission, or revenue-share execution.
No BNA Academy payment/account data in One Time views.
No raw secret, webhook secret, payment method, private invoice URL, or unredacted customer data in UI proof.
No UI implementation before current-state visual audit and Definition of Ready.
affected_surfaces: One Time provider shell Billing IA
One Time provider shell Catalog IA
One Time provider shell Automations IA
One Time provider shell Settings IA

known_current_defects: Billing category does not yet exist as a dedicated One Time provider-shell route module.
Old Operations payment/trial copy still includes active trial-language artifacts that must not be copied into the new Billing UI.
Current provider route-module proof covers CRM, mailbox, and communications but not Billing.
Billing actions need disabled/sandbox/live-gated states before any external payment operation appears.
current_state.after_screenshot_plan: Capture Billing, Catalog, Automations, and Settings states at 1440, 1024, 768, 430, and 390 after implementation.

expanded_phrases.professional: Use a restrained provider operations layout with clear hierarchy, compact tables, state chips, traceable actions, and no debug clutter.
expanded_phrases.payment/access: Show payment state and access state together only through provider-scoped, server-derived records, with all live money/access mutations gated.
expanded_phrases.automations: Reuse the existing automation/outbox patterns and display triggers, previews, and blocked/send states without creating a second automation engine.
expanded_phrases.dashboard: Use an operational overview with metrics, readiness, exceptions, and next actions, not a decorative marketing hero.
expanded_phrases.portal: Keep customer/parent-facing access status separate from provider admin controls and do not imply access is granted before the payment/access lifecycle authorizes it.
expanded_phrases.configured: Replace vague configured/not-configured labels with specific readiness checks and exact next actions.
expanded_phrases.working: Define success as route, registry, state matrix, tests, screenshot, deploy, and live-smoke evidence.
expanded_phrases.clean: Use predictable navigation, compact controls, readable tables, and no nested card walls.

product_quality_expansion.user_facing_goal: A One Time workspace owner can review the Billing system, product catalog, campaign readiness, customer/subscription/invoice/payment states, exceptions, and setup blockers without risking an accidental charge or send.
information_architecture: Provider shell categories: Overview, Catalog, Billing, Automations, Settings.
Overview shows revenue/readiness/exceptions/next actions without raw IDs.
Catalog shows products, prices, status, publish controls, and tax/recurrence disclosures.
Billing shows conversion campaign, customers, subscriptions, invoices/payments, and refund exceptions.
Automations shows billing triggers, notice previews, failed-payment handling, cancellation handling, and send gates.
Settings shows Stripe account readiness, webhook health, policy versions, permissions, and live activation blockers.
visible_layout_rules: Do not place cards inside cards.
Use dense but readable tables for repeated billing records.
Use chips for status and mode, menus for row actions, tabs or segmented controls for subviews, and icon buttons where commands are familiar.
Keep setup blockers visible but not as a giant always-open wall.
Reserve full-width bands/unframed layouts for page sections; use cards only for repeated records or modal/tool panels.
product_quality_expansion.first_party_pattern_interpretation: Use first-party BNA/One Time provider-shell patterns and no GHL/LeadConnector runtime.

design_pattern_references: Existing action registry rows for provider route modules

requirements.statement: Compile and validate the provider Billing UI Product Quality gate before UI implementation.
requirements.expected_result: The UI packet names exact routes, states, actions, data, security, screenshot proof, deployment gate, and implementation split rules.
acceptance_criteria: PQC validation passes for this packet.
Current-state visual audit is required before UI code.
The UI implementation is split if more than three routes, four files, or one major surface would be touched.

requirements.statement: Implement the responsive One Time provider Billing UI inside the dedicated provider shell.
requirements.expected_result: Provider admins can inspect Billing overview, catalog, campaign, customers, subscriptions, invoices, payments, refund exceptions, automations, account readiness, policies, and permissions through scoped views.
acceptance_criteria: All live charge, refund, send, and access actions are disabled or approval-gated until a final launch packet exists.
1440, 1024, 768, 430, and 390 screenshots show no overlap, clipping, or horizontal overflow.
Action and route registry entries exist for every visible action/route.
Focused UI tests and live route smoke pass after deployment.

criteria: Raw intake is preserved.
Affected routes and likely files are listed.
Current-state screenshots are still required before UI implementation.
Old active trial/grace UI copy must be removed or isolated before Billing UI completion.
External Stripe/payment operations are sandbox-only or approval-gated.
Action and route registries are required.
State matrix and screenshot viewports are defined.
Implementation must split if scope exceeds packet budget.
definition_of_ready.blocker: Run 01-current-state-visual-audit and capture provider-shell screenshots before UI code.

loading.how_to_enter_state: Navigate to Billing while route module/data are loading.
loading.expected_visible_message: Provider-scoped billing shell remains readable while data loads.
loading.aria_semantic_expectation: Main Billing landmark and navigation are present.
loading.accessibility_expectation: Loading state is announced without trapping focus.
loading.test_smoke_assertion: Billing route renders loading state without console error.

empty.how_to_enter_state: Load Billing before campaign/customers/subscriptions are seeded.
empty.expected_visible_message: No billing records yet; setup next actions are specific and safe.
empty.aria_semantic_expectation: Empty state is plain text with reachable setup action.
empty.accessibility_expectation: Empty state has enough contrast and no tiny action text.
empty.test_smoke_assertion: Empty Billing route includes no private customer data.

populated.how_to_enter_state: Load Billing with sandbox/test provider billing data.
populated.expected_visible_message: Campaign, subscriptions, invoices, payments, and exceptions are summarized.
populated.aria_semantic_expectation: Tables have headings, row labels, and menu labels.
populated.test_smoke_assertion: Populated sandbox state shows scoped billing rows only.

filtered_empty.how_to_enter_state: Apply a filter with no matching invoices/payments.
filtered_empty.expected_visible_message: Filtered state explains how to clear or adjust filters.
filtered_empty.aria_semantic_expectation: Filter controls have labels and result counts update.
filtered_empty.test_smoke_assertion: Filtered empty state keeps table/header dimensions stable.

error.how_to_enter_state: Simulate API failure for Billing data.
error.expected_visible_message: Error state gives a retry action and safe support next step without exposing secrets.
error.aria_semantic_expectation: Error message is announced and retry is a button.
error.test_smoke_assertion: Error state redacts provider details and secrets.

blocked_setup.how_to_enter_state: Load Settings when Stripe/webhook/Railway/live activation is incomplete.
blocked_setup.expected_visible_message: Specific blocked setup rows explain the missing readiness item.
blocked_setup.aria_semantic_expectation: Blocked setup list is grouped with headings.
blocked_setup.accessibility_expectation: Long blocker labels wrap cleanly at 390px.
blocked_setup.test_smoke_assertion: Blocked setup state includes no secrets and no enabled live action.

preview_only.how_to_enter_state: Open billing notice preview before live send approval.
preview_only.expected_visible_message: Notice preview displays disclosures and shows send as approval-gated.
preview_only.aria_semantic_expectation: Preview pane has a title and labelled controls.
preview_only.accessibility_expectation: Preview and action states are clear without color alone.
preview_only.test_smoke_assertion: Send action remains disabled without exact approval.

success_readback.how_to_enter_state: Run sandbox reconciliation after test-mode Stripe lifecycle smoke.
success_readback.expected_visible_message: Sandbox-only reconciliation shows matched product, price, subscription, invoice, payment, entitlement, and webhook rows.
success_readback.aria_semantic_expectation: Readback summary is in a labelled region.
success_readback.accessibility_expectation: Success state includes text labels and timestamps.
success_readback.test_smoke_assertion: Sandbox readback never includes live mode or real customer identifiers.

permission_denied.how_to_enter_state: Attempt to load One Time Billing from a wrong provider scope.
permission_denied.expected_visible_message: The user cannot view unrelated provider billing records.
permission_denied.aria_semantic_expectation: Permission message is clear and does not leak records.
permission_denied.accessibility_expectation: Focus moves to the denial heading.
permission_denied.test_smoke_assertion: Wrong-scope access is rejected server-side and UI-side.

mobile_drawer_or_detail_state.how_to_enter_state: Open a subscription or invoice detail on mobile.
mobile_drawer_or_detail_state.expected_visible_message: Detail sheet shows key status, customer, invoice/payment, entitlement, and actions without horizontal overflow.
mobile_drawer_or_detail_state.aria_semantic_expectation: Detail sheet/dialog has a label and close control.
mobile_drawer_or_detail_state.accessibility_expectation: Focusable controls stay inside the detail state.
mobile_drawer_or_detail_state.test_smoke_assertion: 390px detail state has no horizontal overflow and all text fits.

findings.user_impact: Billing does not yet exist as a dedicated provider-shell module.
findings.expected_fix: Add Billing IA only after the current-state audit and data/API readiness.

findings.user_impact: Mobile billing tables/details could clip or overflow unless designed as drawer/detail states.
findings.expected_fix: Use responsive table/detail patterns and verify 430px and 390px screenshots.

requirements: Billing, Catalog, Automations, and Settings views use landmark/heading hierarchy.
Tables have labelled columns and row actions.
Menus and dialogs have accessible labels and keyboard close behavior.
Status is text plus chip/icon, not color only.
Mobile touch targets are at least 44px where practical.
Long labels wrap without overlap at 390px.
verification: Playwright accessibility snapshot for Billing route.
Mobile screenshot review for text fit and overlap.

action_states.label: Preview billing notice
action_states.handler_or_blocker: Preview and copy only; live send requires exact approval.

action_states.label: Send notice batch
action_states.handler_or_blocker: Live customer batch send is outside this implementation branch.

action_states.label: Run sandbox reconciliation
action_states.handler_or_blocker: Synthetic test-mode identities only; no real customer/funds/access/email.

action_states.label: Request refund review
action_states.handler_or_blocker: Creates or previews an internal exception record only; Stripe refund execution remains approval-gated.

action_states.label: Execute refund
action_states.handler_or_blocker: No live refund in this branch; requires authorized admin explicit confirmation and final policy.

forbidden_data: private invoice URLs outside authorized scope
raw webhook bodies in UI proof

implementation_batches.scope: Billing records, Automations, Settings, and responsive detail states
instructions: Implement notice preview and setup/readiness states.

context_budget.split_threshold_reason: Billing UI spans several categories and must split if it grows beyond one provider-shell surface.

tests.live_smoke: Run an exact-SHA One Time provider Billing route smoke after deploy; no external charge/send/refund/access mutation.

redaction_rules: Do not store full customer names/emails/phone numbers unless synthetic.
Do not store raw invoice URLs.
Do not store raw webhook payload bodies.
